Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
items.content: Yes Bank has filed a petition with the Supreme Court to review an order from October 15. This order upheld a Bombay High Court ruling that quashed the bank's decision to write off AT-1 bonds. These bonds, worth Rs 8,415 crore, were questioned during Yes Bank's financial difficulties. The high court ruled that the bank's administrator lacked authority for such a write-off.

items.content: RHI Magnesita has reported a remarkable surge in net profit, soaring to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. EBITDA saw a 30 percent growth, reflecting operational enhancements despite challenging economic conditions.

Alzheimer’s may start shrinking two brain regions years before memory loss
items.content: Johns Hopkins scientists have uncovered hidden warning signs of Alzheimer’s disease that may appear up to a decade before memory loss begins. Brain scans revealed that two regions involved in memory and emotion start shrinking before the hippocampus, the area doctors typically examine for signs of Alzheimer’s. These early changes are linked to abnormal tau protein buildup and could provide a powerful new way to identify people at risk.

items.title: Scientists find a simple daily routine linked to less pain and depression
items.content: A simple change to your daily routine could make a surprising difference in how you feel, both physically and mentally. University of Missouri researchers found that older adults who followed consistent daily schedules reported less physical pain and fewer symptoms of depression, even when they struggled with insomnia. Keeping regular times for sleeping, eating, and other activities may help regulate the body's internal clock, which influences mood, sleep, and overall health.
